biotools.summary: A transparent, unit-aware calculator for the mathematical relationship between peptide mass, target concentration and solution volume. It normalizes mg, micrograms, mL and microlitres, shows the formula and includes a reference syringe visualization. Research-use-only software: it does not select a solvent, validate a laboratory method, calculate a dose or provide administration guidance.

documentation.note: README with installation, formula, assumptions, test vectors and research-use-only scope.

biotools.name: Peptide Reconstitution Calculator
